# goslop text fixture — CancelledError/GeneratorExit:pass after await Future
# (niquests sgi lifespan shutdown FP)
lang: python
file: asgi_adapter.py
---
import asyncio


async def run_lifespan(receive_queue, shutdown_complete):
    try:
        await asyncio.Future()  # Wait forever until canceled
    except (asyncio.CancelledError, GeneratorExit):
        pass
    if receive_queue is not None:
        await receive_queue.put({"type": "lifespan.shutdown"})
        await shutdown_complete.wait()
